messages:
jamal: Heads-up — got a customer call. Their monitoring shows pages for svc-id=api-router didn't reach oncall last 10m. Anybody seeing incident-assist suppressing pages?
incident-bot: (automated) Incident Assist suppression activated for routing_key=svc-api due to rate_limit (429s) — suppression window 15m. See runbook: https://redwood.link/runbook/inc-assist-sup :warning:
alyssa: confirming — I see a surge of 429 from notify-proxy around 2024-11-02T13:02:11Z. Oncall channel shows only automated messages, no pages.
sam: pushed small fix to suppression logic last night — added dedupe+rate smoothing. Could be over-eager.
maria: @alyssa can you paste the suppressor logs? I'll check the dedupe counters.
alyssa: paste logs:
```
[13:02:08] suppressor: key=svc-api, recent=120, threshold=50, action=SUPPRESS
[13:02:09] notifier: attempt=3 -> 429
[13:02:10] suppressor: window_extend=900s
```
jamal: that's scary — threshold way below observed. maybe metric bucket overflow?
alyssa: running `kubectl logs -n inc-tooling suppressor-5f4b` — attaching tail:
```
level=warn msg="dedupe-miss" bucket=0 size=0
level=error msg="counter-wrap" name=rate_bucket id=svc-api value=4294967295
```
sam: counter-wrap — unsigned 32-bit overflow. We shipped that on the deploy. Fix incoming. For now we should disable suppression to let pages through.
maria: Agree. I'm going to patch config: `SUPPRESSOR_ENABLED=false` for inc-assist in cluster staging and prod. Rolling now.
devops-bot: Deploy started: inc-assist-config/disable-suppressor by maria — rollout 3/3 pods. CI: green.
incident-bot: manual paging enabled. If you see misses, use `/page oncall`
jamal: Manually paged oncall, they got it. Can we get customer-impact note?
alyssa: Affected tenants: cust-A, cust-B — estimated 12 missed pages over ~9m. No SMS delivery during suppression.
sam: I'll open a PR to switch counters to 64-bit and add unit tests. Risk: small config patch late-night but needed.
maria: For postmortem, we should include detection: alert when suppressor counter >= 2^31 to catch before wrap.
jamal: Thanks all. I'll tag SRE oncall and start initial incident doc. We have a short customer comms draft.
alyssa: small follow-up: the suppressor docs are out-of-date -> I'll update runbook and add safe-mode toggle. :memo:
sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood/incident-tooling/pull/482 (counter->uint64, tests).
devops-bot: Deploy succeeded: inc-assist-config/disable-suppressor by maria — rollout completed. :white_check_mark:
jamal: closing thread for now, moving to incident doc — will post link.
